papers.title: Expert-Guided Forecast Editing for Time-Series Foundation Models (DEFT)
papers.what: Edits a frozen time-series foundation model's forecast at test time by exploiting its predictive samples in a trend-seasonal space and reusing each expensive expert score across components, beating best-of-N, cross-entropy, and Bayesian optimization under matched query budgets across 78 datasets.
papers.builds_on: Chronos (72DFULQQ); Cross-Entropy Method (ZNEMGMWY); Post-Training TSFM Framework (2607.20002)

papers.title: DecoEvo: Score-Decoupled Co-Evolution of Solver and Rubric-Generator Skills in Text Space
papers.what: Co-evolves a solver skill and its grading rubric in text space, but decouples the signals: the solver learns from criterion-level feedback while the rubric is audited for coverage and discrimination independent of solver score, preventing reward hacking and giving 2.8 to 5.0 percent gains over SkillOpt.

papers.title: TurboVLA: Real-Time Vision-Language-Action Model at 32 Hz on an RTX 4090 with under 1 GB VRAM
papers.what: Reports a vision-language-action policy that runs at 32 Hz on a single consumer RTX 4090 using under 1 GB of memory, pushing VLA models from datacenter accuracy demos toward real-time closed-loop control on commodity hardware.

papers.title: Forecasting Realized Volatility with Time Series Foundation Models: A Comparison with Econometric Benchmarks
papers.what: Finds that for realized-volatility forecasting the choice of foundation-model architecture matters more than the broad choice between foundation models and econometric baselines, so a poorly matched foundation model can lose to a simple statistical one.
